edges.parent_basis:
This brief recites the collections it is gathering, and the Clementines are
among them by name: it names the Decretum of Gratian together with the Decretals
of Gregory IX, the Sext, the Clementines and the Extravagants, commits their
printing to the officina populi Romani, and forbids anyone else to reprint them
for ten years under pain of excommunication. An act that names what it gathers
has drawn its own edge.
